GrowthCapabilities.growthIntro: Choose the level that matches your business. Every level runs on the same system: you own the capabilities, we deliver the results.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationPain: You have a strong product or service. But your digital presence is weak, and too few people or AI systems find your business. The result: a clear digital identity, easier to find, capturing new demand.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationIncluded:
• Better Business Blueprint™
• Website optimised for AI and GEO
• Basic CRM setup
• Lead capture ecosystem
GrowthCapabilities.foundationQuantos: Your website, CRM and lead-capture components become digital capabilities you can control and connect.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationHack: The website, CRM and lead capture work together as one system — from being found to receiving a new enquiry.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationPowerUnits: The Better Pack creates the Business Blueprint, builds the website, configures the CRM and deploys the complete lead-capture flow.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationSovereignNode: Better Foundation creates the first connected part of your own digital infrastructure.
GrowthCapabilities.foundationScholarship: Underdog Scholarship: Up to 50% co-investment (bringing it down to ~$750–$1,250).
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceSubtitle: WE ARE BEING FOUND. BUT GROWTH IS STILL HARD.
GrowthCapabilities.relevancePain: You have customers and revenue. But marketing remains manual, growth depends on clicks and your activities do not work together. The result: Turn existing visibility into stronger authority, trust and growth.
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceIncluded:
• Ongoing ecosystem maintenance
• Marketing automations
• Real-world experience design for user-generated content and Proof of Humanity
• Ongoing business development
• Business-to-business positioning
• Project management
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceQuantos: Marketing automations and the digital capabilities required to run and maintain the ecosystem become reusable parts of your system.
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceHack: The Quantos are connected into growth workflows that distribute content, capture demand and move opportunities forward.
GrowthCapabilities.relevancePowerUnits: The Better Pack maintains the ecosystem, designs real-world experiences, strengthens your positioning and manages the ongoing business-development work.
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceSovereignNode: Your existing foundation grows into a connected system for marketing, customer communication and business development.
GrowthCapabilities.relevanceScholarship: Underdog Scholarship: Up to 50% co-investment (bringing it down to ~$1,750–$2,750).
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceSubtitle: WE ARE GROWING. BUT OUR SYSTEMS CANNOT KEEP UP.
GrowthCapabilities.dominancePain: You have the size, the demand and the market. But internal operations and disconnected systems are slowing the business down. The result: Build custom technology and AI infrastructure for complex growth.
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceIncluded:
• Custom business software
• MVP systems
• Internal AI agents with defined permissions and human oversight
• Infrastructure for real-time global operations
• Corporate business development
• Strategic matchmaking
• Investor readiness
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceQuantos: Custom software, MVP components, AI agents and operational tools become modular capabilities with clearly defined tasks.
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceHack: The Quantos are combined into complete systems for sales, onboarding, customer service, reporting or global operations.
GrowthCapabilities.dominancePowerUnits: Master and Alpha Power Units bring together the specialists required to design, build, connect and audit the infrastructure. Corporate business development, matchmaking and investor readiness are delivered through the relevant human-led Power Units.
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceSovereignNode: Your custom software, AI systems and operational workflows become connected infrastructure with clearly defined ownership, access and operating rules.
GrowthCapabilities.dominanceScholarship: Underdog Scholarship: Tailor-made (Custom-structured, strictly for Enterprise-level operations or Whales).
